# PatientGamers — returning player’s combat and AI impressions

- Source: [Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood discussion on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/patientgamers/comments/1qhvbvu/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/)
- Author / publication: SpiderousMenace; Reddit r/patientgamers.
- Language / date: English; exact publication date not exposed in the inspected material.
- Checked / retrieved: 2026-09-09; block page only.
- Archive status: No Wayback Machine capture found (checked 2026-09-09).

## Editorial research note

No original post or comments were available in the mapped source files. The following is retained from earlier editorial research and is not a transcription of the Reddit page:

A returning player praises the painted environments, animation, and interactions among guards. Their examples include officers interrupting coin-induced fights, soldiers reporting sightings, coordinated searches, and shield formations protecting archers. These are detailed player observations worth comparing with the game, rather than proof of its underlying AI rules.

The review is much less positive about repeated maps, abilities losing usefulness, friendly-fire problems, and managing several characters in real time. It describes combat degenerating into repeated attacks and occasional strange behavior loops. A wrapper reportedly improved display and performance, but no exact configuration is provided. The game remains a personal favorite despite these criticisms.

## Access record

The mapped HTML and text files contain only Reddit’s network-security block page. The HTML title is “Blocked”; the page says “You've been blocked by network security” and “To continue, log in to your Reddit account or use your developer token.” The mapped JSON file is also a blocked HTML page, headed “whoa there, pardner!” and stating that the request was blocked due to a network policy. It asks for login or registered developer credentials.

No post text, author/date metadata from the post itself, score, or comments were received. The editorial note above therefore remains unverified against a retrieved copy. In particular, the exact publication date, upvote count, comment count, and wording of the observations about guard behaviour, friendly fire, and the display wrapper are unavailable.
